flightPaths.departs: UNVERIFIED turn angles (Airservices pages give no degrees). Official: departures to the north and east stay on the runway track until a waypoint 4 NM (about 7 km) south, then turn west; other destinations follow SIDs.
flightPaths.arrives: Arrivals from the north/north-east turn left onto the long runway (STAR via BELTA or visual track via ROKDL); ILS available. Straight-in final length not published on the pages found. Night (2300-0600): runway 16 is the preferred arrival runway.

flightPaths.departs: UNVERIFIED turn angles. Runway 34 is the preferred northbound departure runway when used with 27; 33% of departures (2023). Unofficial controller notes (IVAO) give assigned headings 340 for S/SE/W and 260 for NE; not an official source.
flightPaths.arrives: Arrivals from the south: right turns via Essendon STAR/radar vectors, or left/straight-in 0600-2300 with vectors no closer than 3.5 NM (about 6.5 km) from touchdown. So a straight final of at least 6.5 km; the 26 km default is not contradicted but not verified.

flightPaths.departs: Under 1% of departures; no SIDs, used for departures only if absolutely necessary (unofficial IVAO). Not preferred for departures at any hour.
flightPaths.arrives: 2% of arrivals (2023); preferred in combination with 34 in heavy-traffic peaks.
